extraction_metadata.notes: Extracted from a LinkedIn post by Navansh (AI/ML Engineer) featuring a custom infographic about MedSAM.

title: How does MedSAM segment any medical image with one box?
subtitle_or_tagline: A single box. Any medical image. Accurate segmentation.
topic: MedSAM adapts SAM (Segment Anything Model) for medical images via 2D box prompts: image encoder + prompt encoder + mask decoder → 2D segmentation mask.

components.name: Image Encoder
components.role: Extracts visual features from the image.

components.name: Prompt Encoder
components.role: Encodes the user-drawn box (and other prompts).

components.name: Mask Decoder
components.role: Combines image and prompt features to predict the segmentation mask.

architecture.data_flow: Medical Image + Box Prompt -> Image Encoder + Prompt Encoder -> Mask Decoder -> Segmentation Mask

workflow_steps: Step 1 - Select target in the image.
key_claims: One box can segment any medical image.
A single model works across diverse medical-image tasks.
Based on SAM (adapted for medical images).
caveats_or_warnings: Promptable segmentation aid — results vary by image/task and require expert review; not a standalone diagnosis.
